states.name: Neutrals
diplomacy: Chausia declared a war on its rival Signia
Signia's ally Fapele joined the war on defenders side
Signia's ally Isierelia joined the war on defenders side
Chausia's ally Vile avoided entering the war
Chausia's ally Presloia did not join the war as its allies are in war on both sides
Vokoia declared a war on its rival Neaguria
Vokoia's vassal Contania joined the war on attackers side
Vokoia's vassal Pronsia joined the war on attackers side
Vokoia's vassal Hameria joined the war on attackers side
Neaguria's vassal Bybapalia joined the war on defenders side
Neaguria's vassal Bounia joined the war on defenders side
Neaguria's ally Zaktas joined the war on defenders side
Vokoia's ally Fapele joined the war on attackers side
